meta.title: Magical Night in Hoi An Vietnam! Lantern Boat Ride, Street Food & Night Market | Episode 12 #hoian
meta.description:
Welcome to Episode 12 of my Vietnam Travel Series! Today, we are exploring the most enchanting town in the world: Hoi An. Lantern Boat Ride on the Hoai River. Exploring the Night Market & Street Food tour

In this video, we experience the magic of Hoi An at night. From the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge (Chùa Cầu) to the glowing Thu Bon River, this is a night you don't want to miss. Watch as we take a peaceful lantern boat ride and release a traditional lantern for good luck. 🚣‍♂️✨

We also dive into the bustling Hoi An Night Market to try some of the best Vietnamese street food, including local favorites and unique snacks. Whether you're planning a trip to Vietnam or just love travel vlogs, this guide covers all the top places to see in Hoi An after sunset.
In this episode:
✅ Walking through the Ancient Town night view
✅ The historic Japanese Bridge at night
✅ Lantern Boat Ride on the Hoai River
✅ Exploring the Night Market & Street Food tour
✅ Releasing floating lanterns

If you're enjoying my Vietnam series, please SUBSCRIBE and hit the bell icon to stay updated on future episodes! 🔔
